elements.element: Customer has no most-favoured-nation obligation benefiting Vendor.
elements.evidence: Section 7.2 expressly states that Customer has no obligation to disclose or match another provider’s commercial offer for Vendor, and Section 12.3 confirms no most-favoured-customer commitment.

elements.element: The Customer MFN covers only a defined product.
elements.evidence: No Customer MFN exists under Sections 7.2 and 12.3, so the condition requiring a product-scope limitation is absent.

elements.element: The Customer MFN lasts no longer than 12 months.
elements.evidence: No Customer MFN exists under Sections 7.2 and 12.3, so there is no MFN duration exceeding 12 months.

elements.element: The Customer MFN contains reasonable like-for-like comparison carve-outs.
elements.evidence: No Customer MFN exists under Sections 7.2 and 12.3, so the condition requiring comparison carve-outs is absent.
